props.content: This is an intentionally extremely long heading that must wrap inside a narrow three hundred and twenty pixel column without overflowing or clipping its parent container boundary at any viewport

And here is an even longer paragraph of body copy that continues and continues and continues so that the inline-block wrapping, anywhere-break behaviour and line-height choices in both renderers can be compared pixel for pixel across breakpoints and themes without manual guessing or assumptions about what will happen with such extended text content in a constrained width column.

props.label: A button with an unusually long label that should also wrap or size correctly inside the narrow container without breaking layout
